title: City of Sydney — New Year’s Eve transport changes and return planning

facts.fact: The event transport plan says trains do not stop at Circular Quay from 3pm until midnight; alternatives include Wynyard,St James and Martin Place followed by walking.
facts.excerpt: from 3pm until midnight trains will not stop at Circular Quay station.

facts.fact: The return journey can differ from arrival because of closures and crowds; vantage-point capacity should be checked while travelling.
facts.excerpt: The way you arrive during the day will be different to the way you leave after the midnight fireworks.

facts.fact: The Harbour Bridge pedestrian/cycleway closes for the event, so it cannot be treated as an ordinary way to cross between viewpoints at night.
facts.excerpt: The Sydney Harbour Bridge walkway and cycleway will close from 6pm
facts.location: Walking and riding; full source states closure until 2am New Year’s Day
